description: Recolor an image, chart, screenshot or mockup the way someone with color-vision deficiency sees it, and return the recolored image. Use this to SHOW what a design looks like through colorblindness (to check whether it stays readable, pair it with cvdsafe's checkImage). Reads PNG and JPEG — pass `path` for a local file, or a base64 `dataUri`. `type` picks the deficiency (default deutan); `severity` 0..1 sets strength.

dataUri.description: Base64 data URI of the image, if you don't have a file path

path.description: Path to a local PNG or JPEG file, e.g. ./chart.png

name: simulateImage
title: Recolor an image as a colorblind person sees it
